# Unit test for function digits
def test_digits():
    # Single odd digit
    assert digits(1) == 1
    assert digits(3) == 3
    assert digits(5) == 5
    assert digits(7) == 7
    assert digits(9) == 9

    # No odd digits -> 0
    assert digits(0) == 0
    assert digits(2) == 0
    assert digits(4) == 0
    assert digits(8) == 0
    assert digits(2468) == 0
    assert digits(40) == 0

    # Multiple odd digits -> product
    assert digits(235) == 15      # 3 * 5
    assert digits(135) == 15      # 1 * 3 * 5
    assert digits(123456) == 15   # 1 * 3 * 5
    assert digits(999) == 729     # 9 * 9 * 9
    assert digits(7777) == 2401   # 7^4

    # Odd digits mixed with even digits
    assert digits(2222) == 0
    assert digits(25) == 5        # only 5 is odd
    assert digits(14) == 1        # only 1 is odd
    assert digits(1232) == 3      # only 3 is odd

    # Multi-digit numbers with repeated odd digits
    assert digits(111) == 1       # 1 * 1 * 1
    assert digits(335) == 45      # 3 * 3 * 5

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_digits()
